task.title: Resolve V1-V4 from the independent security review of 6ff6327 (awkit-2het), V1 first
task.objective: V1: the default-on PassiveCdpTrace observation sampler checked a page before and after its CDP screenshot but not between, so a protected field shown only inside the screenshot call reached disk, the DOM sample and the Instance Monitor live view. Reproduce it in real Chromium with synthetic fixtures, fix it by opening the shared strict watchProtectedWindow before the first check and writing only after a clean window and re-check, and prove it with a mutation. V2: map the strict window's window-changed verdict to CAPTURE_STALE in captureCore so ordinary page churn is not reported as a protected sign-in surface. V3: add window-off R1b mutation controls for captureElement, captureVisualFrame and captureCandidates. V4: measure the window's diagnosis cost with benchmark:visual-diagnosis. File V1 as a linked security defect, close awkit-2het after a fresh-context independent review, keep awkit-3gtj closed.

acceptance.description: On 080d0e38 a password field shown only inside the observation sampler's own Page.captureScreenshot call is written to disk, kept as a DOM sample and pushed to the live view (verify:trace-protected-capture O4 red, 82/2), while a benign element in the same window still samples (O5 green).
After the fix O4 and O5 are green (84/0); ignoring the window verdict turns exactly O4 red again (82/2); verify:artifacts keeps the passive-observation non-interference checks green.

A benign hash change or iframe inside the window is refused CAPTURE_STALE with no pixels by every entry (baseline 327/4: captureViewport and captureElement said PROTECTED_SURFACE); R1b stays PROTECTED_SURFACE; window-off R1b mutants for captureElement, captureVisualFrame and captureCandidates each return pixels. verify:visual-capture 331/0.
benchmark:visual-diagnosis is re-run after the window landed and its cost and deadline cuts are recorded.
The listed regression suites, typecheck:scripts, build, source-hygiene, verifier-classification and git diff --check pass against the final state.

A fresh-context independent security review of the final implementation; V1 filed as a linked Beads security defect; awkit-2het closed only after that review; state docs updated; dashboard Sources agree.
